reel1.caption:
Got a side hustle idea? Do not buy anything yet. Test it in one week.

Write one line on who you help and with what, tell ten people, do the first job at a fair price, then ask for honest feedback and note your real costs and time.

Comment your side hustle idea below.

reel2.caption:
Not every side hustle offer is real. Three red flags to check before you hand over any money.

Be wary if you must pay to start earning, if big income is promised for little work, or if it only works when you recruit other people. If it sounds too good to be true, it usually is.

Send this to a friend who is starting out.

#sidehustleSA #entrepreneurSA #smallbusinessSA #lekkerhustle

slides.sub: What to start with and what to watch. Swipe.

slides.title: Cleaning
slides.head: Homes, offices and holiday lets.
slides.body: Start with supplies you already have. Watch out for reliability, safety, insurance and clear pricing.

slides.title: Admin help
slides.head: Bookkeeping and admin for busy owners.
slides.body: All you need is a laptop and good organisation. Protect your clients' private data.

slides.title: Baking
slides.head: Take orders by WhatsApp.
slides.body: Start with a few tested recipes. Check food-handling rules with your municipality.

slides.title: Pet care
slides.head: Dog walking and pet sitting.
slides.body: It runs on time and trust. Agree the details clearly and keep good records.

slides.title: Photography
slides.head: Phone or basic camera and a portfolio.
slides.body: Get permission, use a simple contract and store client files safely.
